chosen_submitted_config.principle: what (if anything) is recommended for SUBMITTED_AGENT_CONFIG (enable the feature-router) -- the A6 input; 'unchanged' if null.

false_negative_risk_checked.principle: MUST be true with the random-route control run.

generic_transfer_rate_baseline.principle: 0.04 -- the .420/.421 B1 default-approach baseline, measured the SAME way.

generic_transfer_rate_with_router.principle: the HEADLINE -- held-out variant transfer WITH the feature-router; > 0.04 with CI-excl-baseline is the non-circular live-value evidence.

inference_substrate.principle: verifier_ensemble_against_cached_candidates -- the router classifies + routes over offline variants, no LLM load (1s floor).

median_actions_to_first_levelup_with_rou.principle: ACTION cost WITH routing -- the leaderboard tiebreaker.

missing_verifier_gaps.principle: if no value, the residual generation gap by mechanic class.

null_delta_methodology_note.principle: present when transfer_delta==0.0 -- states the equality is an honest no-value null, not a measurement bug.

offline_reproduced.principle: any newly-solved variant must offline-reproduce to count.

preconditions_checked.principle: records resources verified (offline arcade, recommend_approach importable); pre-empts missing-resource fabrication.

random_route_control_passed.principle: the POSITIVE CONTROL -- the router must beat random-route on the SAME variants.

reproducibility_checksum.principle: content-addressed hash catches silent router/corpus drift on replay.

solve_rate_preserved.principle: HARD gate -- routing must NOT drop solve-rate.

transfer_ci.principle: bootstrap CI on the transfer delta; a claim above baseline requires the CI to exclude the baseline.

transfer_delta.principle: with_router - baseline, emitted explicitly so a null is annotated.

verifier_is_oracle.principle: MUST be false -- the router selects an approach by a LEARNED early-play signal, oracle-DISTINCT from the executable win-check.

winner_generated.principle: did routing to the right approach GENERATE the winning candidate.

null_delta_methodology_note: transfer_delta==0.0 is an honest no-value null under the paired same-variant measurement, not a measurement bug.
